name: cp-v10
idea_origin: Comprobante line, 29 Oct: token accounting of the real DeepSeek traces (history grows ~608 tokens per model call, 431 of them tool results and framing; total tokens are quadratic in the number of model calls) plus the pending candidates c5 (quality), t0 (Skill from level 4), suelo-v1-min (stalled start, size of the risk) and v4-lean-q (one observe per quarter; Leah's branch leah/workspace, not a registered parent)
hypothesis: Pairs take_action + observe even when the serving provider returns no hidden reasoning and the model thinks aloud in the content (DeepInfra-type serving), by seeding the pair on the Continue screen and decoupling the pair from silence.
predicted_behaviour: Pinned to DeepInfra, cold probes pair in 4 of 5 or more (cp-v5a: about half); pinned to GMICloud, still silent and paired.
refutation: Pinned to DeepInfra, pairing stays at about half of the probes, or GMICloud-type serving loses the silence.
change: cp-v9 plus: Turn loop opens with the first three replies spelled out (new_game; observe; the Continue screen already as the take_action + observe pair), step 2 asks for silence only "if you can" and makes the pair independent of any text, step 3 says "from the Continue screen to the last month"; same in the manifest instruction. Motivation: CP6, the provider that serves the call decides whether DeepSeek has a hidden reasoning channel; without it, it narrates and the pair comes out as a coin flip on the first story reply.
